title: Cognos Planning Online Training
description:
About Cognos Planning Online Training

Cognos Planning  Online Training is a finance-managed solution for both operational and business planning with the flexibility to turn the most sophisticated strategy into discreet plans, budgets, and forecasts. It supports traditional budgeting processes, driver-based approaches and enables the creation of rolling forecasts to give real-time visibility into resource requirements and future business outcomes.

Prerequisites For Learning Cognos Planning Online Training

  • Graduates/Post Graduates are eligible.
  • Complete the IBM Cognos Planning Analysts: Build Models (V10.1) course.
  • Knowledge of organization’s data and structure.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Excel.

Terms And Conditions

  • We will Provide Supporting to resolve Student practical Issues.
  • We will provide server Access and 100% Lab Facility.
  • Resume Preparation.
  • Interview Questions & Answers.
  • We will conduct mock interviews. Student also gets 100% supporting before and after getting job.
